questions.q: The mechanical shaft seal keeps water in the pump wet end while…
choices: The motor shaft spins through the volute

questions.q: Which failure signature suggests a motor already at risk?
choices: Slow drip at the base only
Silent seepage with rust on the endbell
Water on the floor away from the pump

questions.q: You should never lubricate O-rings with…
Before removing the pump motor you must…
choices: Power off, lock out, close valves, drain the volute

questions.q: The rotating half of the seal sits on which component?
A chipped ceramic face on the stationary seal half means…
Which is a legitimate reason to recommend motor replacement over seal-only repair?
choices: Shaft is grooved where seal ran

questions.q: First minute after seal installation shows small weeping. This is…
choices: Normal bed-in; check again at 5–15 minutes

questions.q: You gripped the impeller vanes with pliers to hold the shaft. Result?
A dropped shaft during motor separation…
choices: Bends the shaft and destroys the new seal
